overview_description.description:
Seaflight Technologies is a logistics company that creates a network for flown cargo on coastal routes. Seaflight flies close to the water's surface for a huge efficiency gain with their simple, electric, remote-piloted craft.

It was founded in 2022 and is based in Carson, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Seaflight Technologies is a logistics company that offers an electric air cargo drone airline for flown cargo on coastal routes.

product.name: AURAE Electrified Cargo Drone
product.description: A fixed-wing electric cargo drone designed to carry three pallets of goods up to 800 km, capable of operating from short runways under 400 ft.

product.name: Aerodynamic Flow Control Technology
product.description: A system that actively modifies airflow over aircraft wings to increase lift during takeoff and landing and reduce drag during cruise, enhancing range and payload capacity.

product.name: SeaSense Autonomy Suite
product.description: Software enabling autonomous ultra-low altitude flight over water, maintaining stable flight within one wingspan of the surface with remote pilot oversight.

identifier.value: Partnerships for Manufacturing and Powertrain Development

product.name: Partnerships for Manufacturing and Powertrain Development
product.description: Collaborations with industry and academic partners to manufacture drone airframes and develop electric powertrain systems for long-range cargo drones.

product.name: Flight Control Systems Integration
product.description: Collaboration with Airhart Aeronautics to implement advanced fly-by-wire flight control systems for electric cargo drone prototypes.
